items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: they had the Armist brass band with James Williams.

ctx.x: He died just about. He was a bass player. And sometimes he used to play something else. What did he play? Guitar? No, I don't know. Sometimes Bob used to play something else. And there's so many of them, I just can't remember their name. What do you call this man? He used to, they had the Armist brass band with James Williams. They played at the Lyric Theater.
